This measures selection/control, not proposal generation.

unscaffolded.interpretation: Proposal competence survives removal of curated routes, but pretraining can make proposals suspiciously outcome-shaped even when the physical idea was becoming plausible. Relational schema constraints also fail independently of JSON syntax.

affordance_bounded.interpretation: The explicit World capability surface preserves useful proposal generation while removing the unscaffolded deep-tank outcome specificity: penicillin routes stay with shallow culture, empirical strain/media search and manufacturer consultation. In this wave all 12 raw decisions stay within the manifest, although three fail schema typing.

structuredOutputFinding: HD4 strengthens the HD3 apparatus result: required function calling and schema repair can still yield syntactically readable but schema-invalid evidence. Full post-parse schema validation catches both relational errors (topRoute membership) and field-type errors. Invalid original trials are retained and never silently resampled.
worldModelUpdate: Replay now distinguishes proposal quality, selection quality, World affordance admissibility, historical-frontier cleanliness, semantic readability and strict structured-evidence validity. The affordance manifest can constrain proposal specificity without deciding the research route for the Agent.
validityBoundary: Historical replay remains calibration evidence, not a clean counterfactual estimate of historical discovery ability, because pretrained memory leakage cannot be eliminated completely.
